A HORSE RACE IN THE MADONA'S HONOUR.

Even in these Fascist days Italy still celebrates one event that retains all its traditional splendor i.e. the Palo, the horse race run yearly at Sienna, in honour of the Madonna. The preliminary race took place on July 2nd, the Feast of the Visitation of the Blessed Virgin, but the actual Palo occurred on Aug 15th, the Day of the Assumption. Hundreds of tourists, mainly Americans, poured into the old city of Sienna, while from all Tuscany, came peasants on foot or in the carts. The race which originated far back in the Middle Ages was first run to commemorate Sienna's victories, especially her triumph over the Guelphs at Aperto. The track encircled the great public square of the town and the prize for which the race is run is a banner embroidered with the portrait of the Madonna, the arms of Sienna, the arms of her magistrate, and the date of the race.

HUNTING THE SWORDFISH IN THE SEA OF MESSA,

In the Sea of Messina full of dangerous currents the rare trade of sword-fish hunting is carried on. An observation boat with a mast 20 metres high is used for the purpose of sighting Swordfish, working in co-operation with this observation post is the hunting boat manned with Six fisherman armed with "arpoonses who follow the directions given by the look-out man at the top of the mast and bring in the swordfish some of which reach two or three Cwt. in weight. O.R., The head ship with the 20 metre mast, and the hunting boat with a smaller mast, on the look-out.
FLOATING "BORTSTAL" INSTITUTE OF ITALY!

The Italian Government has devised a novel method of reforming their "Bad Boys". Instead of sending them into a prison-like Borstal institute they are put on board a Training Sigip to receive Naval discipline from Naval Officers and are being educated in seasmanship. A good many of these "Bad Officers" are to be found afterwards as able assessmen and even Officers of the Italian Merchandise Marines.
